subject: Unable to connect SecureVault to SSO
body:
Hi team,

We're experiencing a critical issue with SecureVault. Our SSO pipeline has been failing since approximately 48 hours ago. Error message: 'AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: please reauthenticate'

This is impacting 497 users in our Operations team. We've tried restarting the service and clearing the cache but the issue persists.

Environment: EU-Production
Version: 2.5.0

Please advise urgently.
